scripts.deploy:staging: npm run check && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply seensy-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.stats:site: wrangler d1 execute seensy --remote --command "SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(DISTINCT ref) AS sources FROM site_events GROUP BY name ORDER BY count DESC"
scripts.stats:sources: wrangler d1 execute seensy --remote --command "SELECT CASE ref WHEN '' THEN '(direct)' ELSE ref END AS source, COUNT(*) AS views FROM site_events WHERE name = 'view' GROUP BY source ORDER BY views DESC"
